entries.name: Steam
entries.installerNotes: Caskrun can download Valve's Windows installer, create a Steam bottle, and start the installed launcher. Steam account sign-in and gameplay have not been verified.

entries.name: Epic Games Store
entries.installerNotes: Experimental setup downloads Epic's Windows MSI and opens its setup wizard. Complete publisher prompts inside the installer. Sign-in and games remain unverified.

entries.name: GOG Galaxy
entries.installerNotes: Experimental setup uses GOG's published Windows installer manifest and checks the downloaded installer before starting it. Complete any publisher prompts inside the installer. Sign-in and games remain unverified.

entries.name: Battle.net
entries.installerNotes: Experimental setup downloads Blizzard's Windows installer from its official downloader and checks the file before opening it. Complete any publisher prompts in the installer. Sign-in and games remain unverified.

entries.name: Ubisoft Connect
entries.installerNotes: Experimental setup downloads Ubisoft's Windows installer, checks it, and creates a dedicated bottle. Complete publisher prompts inside the installer. Sign-in and games remain unverified.

entries.name: EA app
entries.installerNotes: Experimental setup downloads EA's Windows installer, checks it, and creates a dedicated bottle. Complete publisher prompts inside the installer. Sign-in and games remain unverified.

entries.name: itch.io app
entries.installerNotes: Experimental setup follows itch.io's checked Windows installer download, creates a dedicated bottle, and saves its stable launcher. Complete publisher prompts inside the installer. Sign-in and games remain unverified.

entries.name: Rockstar Games Launcher
entries.installerNotes: Experimental setup downloads Rockstar's Windows installer, checks it, and creates a dedicated bottle. Complete publisher prompts inside the installer. Sign-in and games remain unverified.
